caseNameFull: Gentle, Administrator v. Western & Atlantic Railroad
attorneys: Messrs. John H. Gentle, B. P. Gambrell, and Reuben R. Arnold for petitioner., Messrs. Walton Whitwell and Wm. H. Sunggart for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Court of Appeals of Georgia denied for the want of a final judgment and motion for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis also denied.
